entries.speaker: Matoba
entries.en: Do you want to place a bet?[n]We'll be playing '01.

entries.speaker: Matoba
entries.en: Two of you guys can play.[n]If you win against me, it'll be free.
entries.uk: Можуть грати двоє з вас.[n]Якщо переможете мене — безплатно.

entries.speaker: Matoba
entries.en: You guys want to place a bet again?[n]Same rules, '01.
entries.uk: Знову хочете зробити ставку?[n]Ті самі правила, 01.

entries.speaker: Matoba
entries.en: It'll be free if you win.[n]I'm not going to lose this time.
entries.uk: Переможете — буде безплатно.[n]Цього разу я не програю.

entries.speaker: Matoba

entries.speaker: Matoba
entries.en: It'll be free if you win. Though,[n]I'll probably be the one who does.
entries.uk: Переможете — буде безплатно. Хоча[n]переможу, мабуть, я.

entries.en: Looks like you win. As promised,[n]I'll give you back your money.

entries.speaker: Matoba
entries.en: I win. Well, I hope you continue[n]to have a good time.
entries.uk: Я виграв. Що ж, сподіваюся, ви[n]і далі гарно проведете час.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: H-Hey. Is this really something[n]we should be doing...?
entries.uk: Г-Гей. А нам справді[n]варто таким займатися...?

entries.speaker: Matoba
entries.en: Don't worry, missy. I mean, I am[n]the store owner after all.
entries.uk: Не хвилюйся, панночко. Я ж,[n]зрештою, власник закладу.

entries.speaker: Matoba
entries.en: There is no reason for me to trick the[n]customers. It's just a little game.
entries.uk: Мені нема сенсу дурити[n]клієнтів. Це просто невеличка гра.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't be so worried, Lady Ann.[n]If anything happens, I'll protect you!
entries.uk: Не хвилюйся так, леді Анн.[n]Якщо щось станеться, я тебе захищу!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I suppose... Then let's give it a go!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right! All or nothing, let's do it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, Ryuji! Lend me your shoulder[n]and throw exactly where I tell you to!
entries.uk: Агов, Рюджі! Підстав мені плече[n]й кидай точно туди, куди скажу!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What!? Why the hell do I have to?[n]...Psh, whatever.
entries.uk: Що!? А якого біса я маю?[n]...Пф, байдуже.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, fine, c'mere. Don't fall off.
entries.uk: Гаразд, добре, лізь сюди. Не впади.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay! Here we go!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To play for free...? [fName],[n]we must win!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So, our goal is to get our score to 0.[n]I'll do my best.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wha-What!? M-Me!? I hope you[n]don't regret it...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That sounds like fun![n]Let's do what we can, [fName]!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You're pairing up with me?[n]I'm flattered. I'll do my best.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: We just throw this right into the[n]center, yes? I'm pretty good at[n]keeping my balance.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, I'm up!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Here we go, Ryuji! Let's start the game!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, yeah. Here we go!

entries.en: All right. I'll go first.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I shall go first.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Okay... Here I go.

entries.en: A-Am I going first!?[n]B-Be sure to bury my body!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Can I throw first?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'll go ahead and start.
